**_Your Next Chapter. Our Newest Community.
_** Imagine welcoming the first Residents to a community you helped bring to life—knowing your leadership helped prepare the buildings, develop the team, and put the details in place for a successful opening.
Fleet Landing at Nocatee is seeking a **Director of Campus Operations** to lead Interior and Exterior Maintenance, Housekeeping, and Safety and Security. This is an opportunity to help launch a new community, establish operational standards, and build a team whose work makes a difference in Residents’ daily lives.
We’re looking for a leader who sees both the big picture and the details: someone who can work effectively with a construction team, coach department leaders, and ensure every Resident arrives at a home that is ready to welcome them.
**Our Story
** Fleet Landing’s story began in 1990 with a commitment to helping older adults live well through exceptional service, meaningful relationships, and a welcoming community. Fleet Landing at Nocatee, our new Life Plan Community, will carry that commitment forward.
As a member of the opening leadership team, you’ll help shape how the community operates from day one—building the relationships, service standards, and daily practices that will support Residents and staff for years to come.
**What You’ll Do
** **Help bring the community from construction to operation.
**

* Ensure the operating team receives the training, maintenance information, warranties, and documentation needed to manage the community confidently.
* Align operational readiness with construction milestones and Resident move-in schedules.

**
* Coordinate with Sales, Resident Services, construction partners, and department leaders to prepare Resident units for scheduled move-ins.
* Establish readiness checklists and final inspections to confirm homes are clean, safe, functional, and welcoming.
* Resolve outstanding issues promptly and communicate clearly when concerns could affect a Resident’s arrival.
**Build and lead a strong operations team.
**
* Recruit, develop, and support leaders and staff in Interior and Exterior Maintenance, Housekeeping, and Safety and Security.
* Establish clear expectations, practical procedures, and a service culture grounded in responsiveness, accountability, and respect.

**Deliver reliable, well-managed campus operations.
**
* Oversee preventive maintenance, repairs, housekeeping, grounds, and safety and security services.
* Use WorxHub to manage work orders, maintenance schedules, equipment records, and service performance.
* Manage operating and capital budgets, vendor relationships, and service agreements with attention to quality and responsible stewardship.
* Maintain regulatory and survey readiness, support emergency preparedness, and address operational risks.
* Work closely with the Executive Director and fellow leaders to improve service and support the community as occupancy grows.

* Demonstrated success managing projects, budgets, vendors, and multiple operational priorities.
* A record of coaching staff, developing leaders, and building collaborative teams.
* Clear communication, sound judgment, and the ability to follow through when details, deadlines, and competing needs demand attention.
* A commitment to serving older adults and creating a positive experience for Residents and staff.
* A bachelor’s degree is preferred, along with demonstrated success in facilities management, engineering, business administration, project management, financial management, or related areas.
* Experience opening a new community or transitioning newly constructed facilities into operation is preferred.
**Why Fleet Landing
** This role offers the opportunity to help build something lasting, supported by Fleet Landing’s established experience and commitment to excellence. You’ll have a meaningful voice in opening decisions, the opportunity to develop your team, and the satisfaction of seeing your work reflected throughout the community.

**What is the role?

...

You are the gatekeeper of the customer success at EnduroSat US. You will own the relationship from contract award through the end of mission, ensuring beyond any requirements, that the customer gets their data when and how they expect.

...

An engineering background is critical — enough to read technical documentation, follow a trade, and zoom beyond the requirements into what the customer actually wants to achieve, even if they don’t quite know it yet.
Some of your daily tasks will include

...

Turn what your team learns in the control room into concrete requirements for the SpaceOps mission control suite and hold the line on automation as the fleet grows faster than headcount
* Own the operational commitments we make to customers. Tasking responsiveness, data latency, reporting — and the evidence that we are meeting them

...

Requirements handed over cleanly, technical decisions reaching the program team, and a single reconciled answer going to the customer
* Define the delivery process for the US business. Reviews, gates, documentation standards, and handoffs at the level each mission requires, without overly bureaucratic processes
* Take what works from our teams in Europe.

...

* 12+ years in aerospace or space systems, including 5+ years leading programs or operations, and experience leading other managers rather than only individual contributors
* End-to-end spacecraft delivery.
You have taken at least one program from contract award through launch and into on-orbit operations, and you were accountable for the outcome
* On-orbit operations experience. You have been responsible for spacecraft in flight, including anomalies, and you know what separates a mission that is ready to operate from one that is not
* Strong program management rigor.

...

You can read a requirements document, follow a design trade, and ask the question that exposes a weak answer. Deep design or R&D experience is not required

...

* Constellation or multi-mission operations, where automation and fleet-level tooling matter more than per-spacecraft attention
* Both commercial and government customer experience, including familiarity with government contract and compliance requirements
* Experience standing up a program or operations function at a startup or a new site, rather than inheriting a mature one
* Experience in a distributed or international organization, especially US–Europe
* Familiarity with spacecraft environmental test campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMI/EMC) and launch integration
* Working knowledge of ITAR/EAR
* Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) and standard scheduling tools

**
